title: eludite.navigation.document_outline input
description: Document Outline (View > Other Windows > Document Outline, Ctrl+Alt+T): the symbols of a document (`textDocument/documentSymbol`) as a tree, the member holding the caret selected; clicking one navigates to it.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

show.description: Show the Document Outline window (the menu and the keys do).

filter.description: Set the window's filter box: only symbols whose name contains it (case-insensitively), with their containers, are listed.
